quest.title: A Single Harmony for an Irreplaceable Soul
quest.description: You and Ganyu had agreed to look separately for clues about the woman in Dvorak's story. Now, it's time to meet up...
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x20, Mora x30000, Hero's Wit x3, Mystic Enhancement Ore x6

chapter.num: The Exquisite Night Chimes: Part II
chapter.title: A Single Harmony for an Irreplaceable Soul

talks.objective: Wait until the appointed time (08:00 – 10:00 two days later)
Head to Yujing Terrace and talk to Ganyu

dialogues.speaker: Ganyu
dialogues.text: *yawn* ...Greetings, Traveler and Paimon. Uh... what time is it?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Are you okay, Ganyu? You were nodding off there... Didn't you sleep well last night?

dialogues.speaker: Ganyu
dialogues.text: Ah, I'm fine, don't worry about me. Let's discuss the matter at hand.

dialogues.speaker: Ganyu
dialogues.text: Since last time, I've been thinking a lot about the story Paimon told me.

dialogues.speaker: Ganyu
dialogues.text: In essence, someone rescued a drowning man and performed some music. If that were all there was to it, it could have been many people — human or adeptus.

dialogues.speaker: Ganyu
dialogues.text: But the tune was allegedly so wonderful that the drowning man forgot about everything else, even his own impending death, and only came to his senses after being brought to shore...

dialogues.speaker: Ganyu
dialogues.text: Perhaps there was adeptal power at work in that music that he, as a mortal, could not perceive. Or perhaps he sensed a power surrounding him, but lacked the words to describe it, not knowing where it came from.

dialogues.speaker: Ganyu
dialogues.text: Either way, if this part of the story is true, then the rescuer has to have been an adeptus.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You really think so? But this story's all the way from Fontaine... Isn't this a bit of a long shot?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Also, Paimon's really curious about how people from Fontaine think this fairy lady looked...

choices.text: Maybe they imagined her having wings.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ooh, like a Crystalfly's wings? That would be pretty cool, but Paimon definitely can't imagine any of the adepti looking like that.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Actually, Ganyu — if you had to save a drowning person, how would you go about it?

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: Huh? Me...?

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: Um... well, I'd get them to the shore, and then I'd probably hide behind a tree and watch them for a while...

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: Once I was sure that they were going to be okay, I'd slip away without a sound...

choices.text: So stealthy...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Got it! So basically, Ganyu's the type of person who doesn't like taking credit for her good deeds.

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: No, it's not like that... I'm just not very good at explaining things, and I also find it really awkward accepting other people's gratitude...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, what if this adeptus in the story had a similar attitude? That would explain why she just left without saying a word.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: She was probably thinking something like... *clears throat* "Hmph! One was merely passing by, and saw fit to address this egregious disruption to one's graceful zithering at once. You may keep your thanks to yourself."

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: Haha, that was actually a very good impression of Cloud Retainer, Paimon.

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: As far as I'm aware, Cloud Retainer isn't the most musically gifted... Still, we can't completely rule her out just yet.

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: Umm... if we set off now, we could head to Mt. Aocang and ask her about it.

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: You'll be able to confirm either way if it's her, and I can... um...

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: ...I've been in Liyue Harbor for so long now that I'm just not as familiar with the adepti anymore. If there's anything we want to know about them, she's the best person to ask.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Sounds great! And we're pretty close with Cloud Retainer by now, so we probably don't even need to bring her food this time, right?

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: I've prepared a gift for her to mark the festival, just in case. However...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You still have some reservations?

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: Um... Cloud Retainer spends most of her days studying mechanisms in her abode. She's on her own so much of the time that the moment she has someone to chat with, she just...

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: ...Never mind. I promised I'd help Mr. Dvorak, and now that I've made the contract, I can't be having second thoughts.

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: Traveler, Paimon, let's set off for Cloud Retainer's abode.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Seems like this was a tough decision for Ganyu, but she's made up her mind now.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon gets why she'd be so anxious... Okay, how about this: If Cloud Retainer tries to start telling stories about her again this year, we should pipe up and change the topic...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait, did she leave already? Hey, Ganyu, wait up!

choices.text: So cute...
Maybe they gave her horns.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Then she'd look just like Ganyu! ...Hmm, guess that does technically make sense.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whew... Paimon's so tired from trying to keep up. Don't either of you need to take any breaks? *pant*

dialogues.speaker: Ganyu
dialogues.text: I can't believe it... Cloud Retainer is not here.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Did we miss her?

dialogues.speaker: Ganyu
dialogues.text: She doesn't like to travel, so in the past, it's always been the other adepti who come to visit her during the festivals...

choices.text: Could she be busy with something else right now?

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: True... now that I think about it, Cloud Retainer would be quite capable of taking care of anything on her own... there's no need to worry about her.

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: Since she's not here... I guess the next step is to check all the other adepti abodes, one by one.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh-oh... Will it involve a lot more traveling?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Um... Ummm...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Got it! Paimon has a great idea!

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: Please go on, Paimon.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Our goal here is to find the adeptus that helped Dvorak's ancestor, right?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We can't hear any music right now, but if she's really as nice as the story suggests, she'd definitely come to help anyone who was drowning, right?

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: Yes, I think that's fair to say...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Sooo, all we have to do is get {NICKNAME} to pretend to fall into the water, and the adeptus will come to the rescue!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: If you're so sure, why don't you try?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You know perfectly well that Paimon can't swim! Paimon would sink like a rock!

choices.text: Hmm, I just think it's a bad idea...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ugh, just trust Paimon! The water's pretty deep over there. Quick, swim to the very center!

choices.text: Ugh, I guess I can give it a try...
Could she have run into trouble?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Somehow Paimon doubts that anything could cause serious trouble for her...

talks.objective: Swim to the center of the pool

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Someone carries you ashore, so quickly that you don't catch who it is...

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: What is going on?

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: How do you feel right now?

dialogues.speaker: Ganyu
dialogues.text: Uh... Shenhe, and the Conqueror of Demons...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wh—Why don't you say something...? *sigh* Please don't make Paimon explain it...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Okay fine! Paimon will explain.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We're looking for an adeptus who's good at being a lifeguard and playing music.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But if the adepti aren't gonna stay at home, then how are we supposed to find them?

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: It wasn't me.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh, yeah, so this adeptus is most likely a woman...

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: #And I am not an adeptus. As you both already know, {NICKNAME} and Paimon.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Heh... Okay, so this is Paimon's fault...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: No way Paimon would've suggested this idea if she'd known how awkward this was gonna be...

choices.text: I'm fine.

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: Glad you're okay.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You're leaving already?

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: As far as I know, the one you seek is no yaksha. And one last thing...

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: ...Your actions here caused others a great deal of worry. Do not repeat them again in the future.

response.speaker: Shenhe
response.text: As ever, the Conqueror of Demons comes and goes just like the wind.

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: R—Right... I didn't dare to say a word just now.

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: How's your training going, Shenhe? Have you made any plans for Lantern Rite? We could spend it together in Liyue Harbor, if you'd like?

response.speaker: Shenhe
response.text: I had planned to spend the festival with Master this year, however...

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: Oh, speaking of Cloud Retainer, when did you see her last?

response.speaker: Shenhe
response.text: Earlier this morning. She set off for Mt. Hulao at dawn.

response.speaker: Shenhe
response.text: I noticed she was using an adeptus art of some kind to protect a mechanism that looked like a boiler. Maybe it was a gift for Mountain Shaper... I did not inquire.

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: Ah, so we just missed her...

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: Please excuse me for a moment. I think I'll leave the gift in her abode.

response.speaker: Shenhe
response.text: Sure. Thank you.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It sounds like Ganyu and Shenhe have gotten a lot closer recently!

response.speaker: Shenhe
response.text: Yes. During the summer and winter, I continue to train with Master. In the other months of the year, I have been learning to adapt to human life in Liyue Harbor.

response.speaker: Shenhe
response.text: Ganyu arranged accommodations for me in the city, and also recommended several work positions for me...

response.speaker: Shenhe
response.text: But when I try to blend in by referring to her as "Ms. Ganyu" or "Lady Ganyu" like the others, she says I mustn't address her like that.

response.speaker: Shenhe
response.text: Sometimes I'm supposed to copy other people, sometimes I'm not... It's a little difficult to keep track of everything.

choices.text: Ganyu just doesn't want you to be too courteous around her.

response.speaker: Shenhe
response.text: Oh, is that what it is... Noted.

response.speaker: Shenhe
response.text: So, you came looking for Master today because you wanted to ask her about the mystery adeptus, is that right?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yep.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, speaking of that, have you ever heard any music while out training in the mountains?

response.speaker: Shenhe
response.text: Music...? What is that?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It's... a kind of happy or relaxing sound! Or, uh... a nerve-wracking sound... or even a terrifying one.

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: Okay, I'm done. I also left her a note so that she knows where to find us. We won't miss her again.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yay! That's really helpful, thanks!

response.speaker: Shenhe
response.text: We were just talking about this thing called "music." And based on Paimon's description... I do believe I hear it every day. Please follow me.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ooh, really? Great, let's go!

choices.text: Ganyu gets embarrassed when people call her "Lady Ganyu."
Sorry for troubling you both.

talks.objective: Follow Shenhe to her cultivation place

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: This is the place. I enjoy training here to the sound of music.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Mm... hmm...?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ahh, aaah!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh no, Paimon's gone deaf! Paimon can't hear anything!

choices.text: Me too...

response.speaker: Shenhe
response.text: The faint sound of birdsong, the quiet murmur of the streams... These are relaxing sounds. Are they not the music of which you speak?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh... heh... Paimon wasn't quite done with the description...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Okay fine, it's all Paimon's fault! What we're looking for are not the sounds of nature, but melodies played on special instruments.

response.speaker: Shenhe
response.text: And a melody is...?

choices.text: Go on, Paimon, sing us a nursery rhyme!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey, don't you patronize Paimon! Hmph, let's get one thing straight: Paimon knows plenty of nursery rhymes, but Paimon does not sing on demand! ...Without payment.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey, why don't you just sing that one melody Shenhe's heard before? It'll probably help her to understand what we're talking about...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Alright.

response.speaker: Shenhe
response.text: Was that... from the opera that Yun Jin sang?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Mm-hmm! That was a melody, and melodies can be called music!

response.speaker: Shenhe
response.text: ...It felt like I was transported back to the past. In my mind's eye, I could see the Xiao Lanterns lighting up the night sky again...

response.speaker: Shenhe
response.text: ...We're all there, raising our glasses and drinking to our hearts' content on the Jade Chamber...

response.speaker: Shenhe
response.text: As I watched Yun Jin's performance, I felt a warm sensation in my heart... And as the drink reached my stomach, it went from warm to hot...

response.speaker: Shenhe
response.text: When you hummed that melody just now, feelings from a whole year ago came right back to me, as strong as they were on that day.

response.speaker: Shenhe
response.text: ...So that's the power of music.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wow, Shenhe... that was so deep!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Music definitely has the power to bring up memories. It's like a time capsule with all the special moments from our life squished inside!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What about you, Ganyu? Are there any melodies that have left a deep impression on you?

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: Um... I don't remember if my parents ever sang any lullabies to me.

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: I know some local folk songs. And a few other things come to mind, too...

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: The songs of the sailors down at the docks, the little ditties that the vendors call out in front of their beloved shops, the tunes of folk artists performing on the streets...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: All the sounds of Liyue Harbor...

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: Yes, that's right.

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: In the past... whenever I heard the sound of those tunes, I always felt that they were worlds apart from me.

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: Many in Liyue probably view me as a non-human... and they are right, in the sense that I never could connect with humans' artistic expression and their sentiments. So I haven't been able to integrate into their community, and be a part of their lives.

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: At least, that's the view I held in the past. Only more recently did I start to realize that... the only barriers are ones that I have erected with my imagination.

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: The way those melodies make me feel isn't all that different from other people after all. They're about mundane details of everyday existence, life's ups and downs, joys and sorrows...

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: Even though we come from different backgrounds, and have different stories to tell... when it comes down to the most common things that we see and experience around us each day in the city...

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: ...In that sense, we're all the same.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You go, Ganyu! You're really making progress! You have loads of friends in Liyue Harbor when you think about it, like ...Hmm, okay, maybe some of them are more like coworkers and bosses, but at the very least, Keqing and Shenhe are your friends now, right?

response.speaker: Shenhe
response.text: Yes. I am.

response.speaker: Shenhe
response.text: Technically speaking, we should refer to each other by the conventional forms of address used among fellow disciples. But now that I know what constitutes a friendship... I do believe we are more friends than co-disciples.

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: ...Thank you, everyone.

response.speaker: Shenhe
response.text: Once the days are warmer, I would like to host you at my home in the city. Please invite Keqing as well.

response.speaker: Shenhe
response.text: I've planted many types of flowers. I'm sure some of them will be to your taste.

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: Ah... you are too kind, I couldn't possibly...

response.speaker: Shenhe
response.text: Nonsense. You are my friend.

response.speaker: Shenhe
response.text: I have cultivated and cared for the flowers just as you taught me. Once you've seen them for yourself, I am sure you can advise me how to do an even better job next time.

response.speaker: Shenhe
response.text: I will save some for decoration. We can feast on the rest.

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: Then... thank you in advance. Wait, what is that saying again? "If you insist"?

response.speaker: Shenhe
response.text: ...Do people say that? I'm not completely sure, either.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It doesn't matter, okay! You got the point across, no need to split hairs. Paimon's more concerned about your idea of a girls' night out... Eating flowers? Really? ...Does this have anything to do with you both being the disciples of that illuminated bird?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I doubt Keqing will be munching on any flowers...

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: Hmph! Who dares refer to one not by one's adeptus title, but merely as "that illuminated bird"?

response.speaker: Shenhe
response.text: Master.

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: Our greetings, Cloud Retainer.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Aaah, there it is! The illuminated bird has landed!

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: Double hmph! Now she has the gall to use "it" rather than "she"! Even after being chastised once already! Huh, barely a moment has passed since we last met, and yet your impertinence has reached new heights. Very well, if you refuse to learn your lesson, one shall scold you no further.

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: One has received your message from Ganyu. On the matter of the adeptus you seek, one suspects to know their identity.

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: Well? Shall one lead the way?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Yes please, Cloud Retainer.

response.speaker: Shenhe
response.text: I still have to complete my training for today, so I will bid farewell to everyone here.

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: Very well. Await my arrival at one's abode later this night. On this special occasion, you should indulge yourself with some savory dishes.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Happy Lantern Rite, Shenhe.

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: If you want to release a Xiao Lantern, come and find us anytime.

response.speaker: Shenhe
response.text: Thank you, everyone. Happy Lantern Rite to you too.

choices.text: Ganyu, why don't you sing that folk song you sing to Glaze Lilies?

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: Uh... Huh!?

choices.text: My condolences, Paimon.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, phew! Paimon hasn't gone deaf after all! Paimon heard you when you just spoke!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...Anyway, uh... where is this music?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Is this... Guili Plains?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Cloud Retainer, why did you bring us here?

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: Ganyu is of course familiar with the name "Guizhong," but have you ever heard of her?

choices.text: I've definitely heard it somewhere.

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: Guizhong is another name of Haagentus, the God of Dust. She was extroverted in nature, and adored social gatherings and inventions alike.

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: Long ago, this region was yet a prosperous assembly. Guizhong often invited her friends to visit her home, reserving for us seats around the largest stone table.

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: Sea Gazer would always bring out his latest treasure and place it upon the table. *sigh* He could be quite the braggart... Though usually a mild-mannered fellow, when it came to those collectibles he was so fond of, he always loved to show them off.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon remembers that name! So that's what Sea Gazer was like...

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: He was an old friend and a former rival. One has many memories of him...

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: Once he had brought out the treasure, it would predictably become the center of attention. Neither Guizhong nor one was content to let him just steal the spotlight, so we would then also present our proudest mechanical creations.

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: As adepti, we were each gifted in our own ways, and naturally proud of our accomplishments in our respective fields of expertise. As a result, one often quarreled with Sea Gazer.

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: His treasures were not even of his own making. He just used his exploration skills to dig them out of the ground! How, pray tell, could he compare to me, when every single one of one's accomplishments was crafted by one's own hand!?

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: Cloud Retainer, you are getting competitive again...

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: ...Ahem, one digresses. Regardless, every time an argument occurred, Guizhong would come over to watch us during our mutual lambastings. On some occasions, she would join in, and on others, she'd take one of us by the limb, and start uttering the most ridiculous nonsense.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What kind of nonsense?

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: No kind of nonsense were we spared. Sometimes, she would brazenly opine "Ahh, why argue between yourselves when neither of you could ever hope to beat me?" Other times, she would make unsolicited suggestions such as "Once you two are done arguing, let's go to the foot of the mountain and grill some meat..."

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: She always sought to make everyone happy, and one must say, she had quite the gift for it — no matter what nonsense she said, one never felt bothered or offended.

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: ...It also helped that she never referred to one as "that illuminated bird" or "lady bird."

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You...! Come on, get over yourself!

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: Hah. Anyway, just as our impassioned arguments would reach the apex of acrimony, Marchosius would bring his delectable dishes to the table.

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: Who would dare snub the Stove God and his wondrous creations? At the sight of him, we would all immediately drop the argument, and prepare the table for a night of feasting and drinking...

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: Heh, back then, one was always bothered by how the cups Rex Lapis brought were always too square for one's taste. Can you see yourselves ever enjoying a drink from a square cup?

choices.text: That does sound annoying.

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: Precisely! So as you can see, even one as great as Rex Lapis was not immune to making the occasional blunder.

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: Even one could never find fault with Marchosius' cooking. As we ate, Guizhong would continue to find topics for conversation, filling the table with humor and laughter.

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: Each of those old fossils had their character flaws and points of obstinacy. So why was it that whenever we dined together, we always had a marvelous time?

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: We would drink together from a spot high in the mountains, until the moon set and the sun rose, and only then would the banquet finally come to an end.

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: Streetward Rambler would often remain to admire the flowers with Guizhong before returning to her own abode. The Glaze Lilies were far more abundant back then... entire fields of them would appear to the eye as a veritable sea of flowers...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Streetward Rambler...?

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: That would be Ping. You probably know her as "Madame Ping."

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, okay... Wait, this is a lovely story and everything, but didn't we come here to find that adeptus from Mr. Dvorak's story?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Or are you saying that... it was Guizhong? Didn't she, um... already, um...

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: Alas... Long has one avoided this place for precisely that reason. The sights here are a reminder of a time long gone, and evoke much sorrow.

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: One should have guessed that you would disrupt one's poignant moment of mourning with your incessant questioning!

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: No matter... one will share the whole story with you now.

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text:
2D Closing Cutscene 
Cloud Retainer: In times gone by, one quarreled oft with Guizhong concerning mechanical principles. We each had our ideals, and neither would yield.
Cloud Retainer: Under the pretext of a social gathering, one invited the impartial Rex Lapis to judge the quality of our creations...
Cloud Retainer: But Rex Lapis declared that Guizhong's Obscuro Vulpes Mechanism was superior, hmph...
Cloud Retainer: Though one was too proud to acknowledge it, in one's heart, one knew that Guizhong was indeed the superior talent in the mechanical arts...
Cloud Retainer: As for the story between Guizhong and Streetward Rambler, that begins with a certain bell.
Cloud Retainer: In Guizhong's opinion, while mechanisms were no substitute for human composers, they were yet capable of producing simple but fine melodies.
Cloud Retainer: But Streetward Rambler believed music to be an expression of the soul, an emotional enterprise that could never hope to be replicated by machinery.
Cloud Retainer: They argued endlessly, until one asked Rex Lapis to intercede. He confiscated the bell, and designated it for ceremonial use.
Cloud Retainer: Thereafter, one would often find them convening in the mountains, discussing music, mechanics, and all the affairs of the mortal world.
Cloud Retainer: But these good times were not to last. War broke out between the gods, and soon engulfed the Guili Plains.
Cloud Retainer: Guizhong was overpowered by the enemy, and fell in battle. When Streetward Rambler and I arrived at the scene at long last, all that remained among the ruins... was her lifeless body.
Cloud Retainer: After this, at Streetward Rambler's request, Rex Lapis granted her the Cleansing Bell for safekeeping.
Cloud Retainer: To honor our friend's memory, one made a few finishing touches to her ballistic device...
Cloud Retainer: Many Lantern Rites have passed since then... many greetings and goodbyes.
Cloud Retainer: Upon what do you gaze? The Guili Plains?
Streetward Rambler: No, it's... everything. We think of human life as like a lantern that's lit one minute and extinguished the next, but are we adepti so different? Perhaps, as dust settles after a storm, we too must one day return to the world below.

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: One has always been austere and private by nature, and has never relished socializing. One's dealings with Guizhong were borne out of discussions on the discipline of mechanics.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What? You have loads of friends! And you seem pretty chatty...

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: Just because one is not ignorant of social graces does not mean one is fond of them! One is perfectly capable of partaking in conversation despite being introverted.

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: But in the end, one is nothing like Streetward Rambler. She is dauntless but thoughtful, not to mention eloquent and wise. Moreover, her friendship with Guizhong was far greater than one's own...

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: Back when they were rivals, they would often compete against one another in the realm of musical composition.

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: That Cleansing Bell was one of Guizhong's proudest works, having the ability to both compose and perform...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait, that's weird. Didn't Madame Ping say she pestered an old friend for that bell?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And she also said something about being a vain beauty when she was young, or something.

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: Streetward Rambler, a vain beauty? Hah... My foot.

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: That bell has a sad history. Clearly, she refrained from sharing with you the truth of its origins, since the right time had not yet come.

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: As for her "old friend"... who else could it be?

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: As soon as Streetward Rambler heard that a certain "Zhongli" wished to borrow the Bell, she realized that the man was none other than Rex Lapis, and that he had made an enormous decision.

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: After all, we all have known each other for several millennia. Some things between us are implicitly understood.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Whoa, so they were talking in secret code? Paimon did not see that one coming...

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: Hmph, enough of your intrusions... Where was one up to? ...Ah, yes. One remembers now.

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: The Cleansing Bell is powered by a mechanical art, and can be used to great effect as an accompanying instrument. After the passing of its creator, it was used on numerous occasions during rites of parting.

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: But Streetward Rambler did not acquire it from Rex Lapis for the purpose of producing further funerary tunes. No, each time she rang it, it was to play the tune that Guizhong composed on it.

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: The two once clashed over their beliefs about the meaning of music. Who would have thought that with Guizhong's passing and Streetward Rambler's mourning, two tunes composed in discord would eventually become one harmonious composition...

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: Once upon a time, Streetward Rambler also loved gatherings, liquor, and music. But after Guizhong passed, she preferred her own company. She could often be found sitting alone at a mountain summit, contemplating and reminiscing with her zither.

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: The music would go from mournful, to soothing, to impassioned...

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: Many years passed before she finally composed a melody to her satisfaction. In celebration, she played the tune to the clouds. Regrettably, one has only ever heard her play that tune once.

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: Which brings one back to the matter you've been investigating... Perhaps it was during that performance that the ancestor of your Fontaine friend fell into the water, and was saved by Streetward Rambler.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But... if she was so happy with the melody, why would she only play it once?

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: One was also greatly perplexed by this. After suppressing one's curiosity for a long while, one finally approached her, and asked why she would retire the tune after having spent so long on it.

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: In response, she said...

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: "Though the strings that played that melody survive, the one who inspired it is gone. Tell me, Cloud Retainer... when the one attuned to my soul is no longer here, who else could hope to understand this tune?"

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Aw... Poor Madame Ping...

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: I just remember being taken care of by you when I was young. Once the Archon War came to an end, I stayed behind in Liyue Harbor to honor my contract.

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: Although I met Guizhong a few times, I never knew anything of this particular story...

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: Guizhong was quite the visionary, but tragically passed before her time. Her manuscripts still lie unfinished in the Realm of Clouds... the blank pages give one cause for contemplation on what might have been.

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: Had you not decided to search for that mystery adeptus, perhaps these stories, too, would have been lost to the sands of time.

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: As of now, you know the truth: That the adeptus who rescued the drowning man was none other than Streetward Rambler.

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: Do you intend to discuss this with her?

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: Do you mean... Ping might find the topic too distressing?

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: Precisely. The passing of our old friend is a heavy topic that both of us are usually careful to avoid.

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: If I may be so bold... Cloud Retainer, could it be that this is just your own personal opinion?

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: Oh? How so?

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: I've been in Liyue Harbor for quite a long time now, and I've witnessed many farewells along the way. So I, too, am well acquainted with the pain of the passing of a loved one.

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: But this doesn't bring the city or its people to a standstill. They have to keep moving forward.

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: Someone as perceptive and wise as Ping will surely have come to understand and embrace this.

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: Though these immortal mountains have lost an adeptus, the harbor of mortals has gained a wise elder.

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: No loss can ever be undone, but there is always much that can still be gained.

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: Ping has helped countless people, and will guide many others in the years to come. And all to whom she extends a helping hand become her friends. People she can admire flowers and discuss music with.

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: Though it is heartbreaking to lose a kindred spirit, life goes on... because there are new friends waiting for you further down the road.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Ganyu is right.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We even asked Madame Ping what she thought about adding a music festival to this year's Lantern Rite!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: When we get back, why don't we just ask her if she'd like to perform? Maybe we could even get her up on stage!

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: ...Hah, you youngsters and your imaginations.

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: Why don't you come with us?

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: It's been a long time since you last spoke with Ping. And Liyue Harbor is always decorated so beautifully during the festival period...

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: Is not every Lantern Rite the same in this regard? Were there ever anything new to discuss, one and Ping could meet any day of the year.

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: I disagree. Each new day and each new year is different from those that have come before. How long will you simply let them pass you by?

choices.text: If nothing else, do it for Ganyu.

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: ...Hmm, the edibles she brought this time were indeed quite delectable...

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: ...Very well.

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: Then one will be off. If the other old fossils have sneaked away into the city to amuse themselves, one shall soon find out...

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: Alright, we should be getting back to the harbor as well. We don't want to keep her waiting.

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: *sigh* Once the Guili Assembly, now the Guili Plains...

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: Say... if we planted flowers there and cared for them carefully enough, do you think that one day, we'd be able to recreate the sea of Glaze Lilies?

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: Allow one to take back one's praise from a moment prior. You are still far too given to flights of fancy, child.

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: What...!? Cloud Retainer? Y—You were still listening?

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: One observed that you were making no effort to leave and returned to chasten and hasten you! This time, one is departing in earnest.

choices.text: Do it as a favor for me?
I don't think I'd really mind.

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: Then you are most tolerant. But that is its own virtue.

choices.text: I'm not sure.

talks.objective: Return to Liyue Harbor and talk to Madame Ping

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa! Madame Ping, and Cloud Retainer...?

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: It appears you made haste after all. One arrived but moments before you.

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: Bless my soul, to what do I owe the honor? How nice of you all to come and visit me...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Miss Illuminated Bird, haven't you said anything yet?

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: Said what, precisely? And why should one be tasked with saying it?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: 'Cause you're the one who's known Madame Ping the longest!

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: Streetward— Ahem, or rather... presumably, you would prefer to be addressed as "Ping"?

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: Ohoho... Cloud Retainer, you are uncommonly polite today.

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: One... Uh... Hmm...

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: Given that Lantern Rite is almost upon us, the weather in the city is most pleasant, and a sweet floral fragrance lingers in the air...

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: Ahem... Ganyu, please continue from here!

dialogues.speaker: Ganyu
dialogues.text: Huh!?

dialogues.speaker: Ganyu
dialogues.text: A—Alright...

dialogues.speaker: Ganyu
dialogues.text: So, this all started because we were trying to help Mr. Dvorak find the adeptus who saved his ancestor's life...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Ganyu recounts the story to Madame Ping...

dialogues.speaker: Ganyu
dialogues.text: Cloud Retainer informed us that the one who played that melody and rescued the drowning man was none other than yourself.

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: Ah... let me think... Yes, I do believe I recall that encounter...

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: What a long time ago that was... I'm surprised that you still remember it.

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: Even more astonishing, perhaps, is the fact that this story has survived this long at all, when mortal lives are so very brief...

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: Hehe... It appears that she has proven herself right once again.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Who's "she"...?

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: We like to call her "Guizhong." From the look in Cloud Retainer's eyes, I sense that she has already told you all about her.

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: *sigh*... Albeit reluctantly, one might add.

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: Hehe, there is no harm done.

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: After all, Lantern Rite's very purpose is to commemorate the heroes who gave their lives for Liyue.

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: Although Guizhong did not live to see the splendid sights of today, she was as much a hero as any other.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh... so how has she proven herself right again, exactly?

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: Once upon a time, she said to me that humans were a weak form of life that she wished to protect with her wisdom.

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: But as she interacted more and more with them, her opinions on them began to change.

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: She marveled at the beautiful complexity of their spirits... the sheer splendor of all they could accomplish through their hard work and intelligence.

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: She told us that to underestimate human potential would be to make a grave mistake...

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: With the smallest amount of guidance, enormous power can be unleashed in them...

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: And a human who has reached their full potential may well be her equal. Someone who could have as much to teach an adeptus as to learn from them.

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: Hmph, she always had a way with words.

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: That her mechanical accomplishments were judged superior to one's own was, one suspects, in large part due to her sheer eloquence.

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: Speaking of mechanics, Cloud Retainer, do you still remember that potted plant mechanism? The one that the two of you gave me as a gift.

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: Of course. Guizhong and one both put an immense amount of effort into that gift. It would be no overstatement to call it a testament to each of our individual technical genius...

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: As Guizhong once said: "It takes every blade of grass and every flower to make a homeland."

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: ...When I see the sight of Liyue Harbor before us today, I am reminded of this.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Madame Ping looks very emotional right now...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Well, she's been through a lot in her time...

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: *sigh*... Of all of us, it was Guizhong who was the fondest of these grand and exciting occasions.

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: If she were still with us, I'm quite sure she would still be trying to best Cloud Retainer's finest works at every opportunity...

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: Liyue Harbor is always filled with the sound of music at this time of the year... If she were here, one is certain that she would seek you out to discuss and debate the virtues of various melodies.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, yeah! Music!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We've been dying to ask: What was the melody that you played back then?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, also, with you being such a music expert and all, why don't you join the concert as a performer?

dialogues.speaker: Ganyu
dialogues.text: I can make arrangements right away!

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: Oho... As much as I don't wish to dampen your enthusiasm...

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: It's been a long time since I played this zither. My fingers don't have the dexterity they once did...

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: And whenever I play that tune... it always reminds me of her. I start wondering what she would think of the changes I've made to her melody...

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: There was a period of time whenever I started strumming, it almost felt like she was back again, sitting right there on the stone stool next to me, chatting away. Skybracer and Sea Gazer, too... looking just like they did in the old days.

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: No matter how much time goes by, the moment that melody starts playing, it transports me right back to that time in my memory...

dialogues.speaker: Ganyu
dialogues.text: So the past still weighs heavily on your heart?

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: I would be lying to myself if I claimed to have completely moved on.

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: But that is not to say that grief doesn't get easier with time.

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: ...Despite the sadness, I have found many things that bring me joy in life. It is simply the nature of the world in which we live that even if one wished to mourn for an eternity, it would be a nigh-impossible feat.

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: Just look at this potted plant. Isn't it stunning?

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: It takes an honest and open mind to confront and conquer grief. You have indeed made progress.

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: Hehe...

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: Be that as it may, I shall leave the Lantern Rite stage to the youth of today.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, if you're sure...

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Granny!

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Whoa, what's everyone doing here? Did something bad happen?

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: Ah, and now we've spooked Yanfei. No, no, everyone's just here to give me their regards for the holiday...

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Oh? That's wonderful! I'm glad.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Well, in that case: Happy Lantern Rite everyone.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Happy Lantern Rite.

dialogues.speaker: Ganyu
dialogues.text: Happy Lantern Rite. Oh! I... I just remembered that I have some, uh... work to do at Yuehai Pavilion that I need to discuss with Yanfei. I haven't been able to find a chance until now...

dialogues.speaker: Ganyu
dialogues.text: I will leave Mr. Dvorak in your capable hands. Cloud Retainer, Ping, we will be off for now.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Huh? Does it have to be right now? Which case is this again? Hey, Ganyu...

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: Ahh... It seems Ganyu still has much to learn when it comes to the art of deception.

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: What a pity... she has learned nothing of one's ability to carry a conversation.

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: Since it's been so long, Cloud Retainer, why don't you stay? I'll make a cup of tea, and we can chat a while.

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: Gladly. This was one's intention as well.

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: When you next see the Fontaine musician, please give him my regards. I'd like to wish him the very best with the concert.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You got it, Madame Ping!

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: Thank you all... I think you've listened to enough of my nattering for one day.

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: As for that melody, I will play it for you all another time. Goodness knows I need to practice it first.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, that'd be great! We'll look forward to it!

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: Hehe...

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: When that time comes, wherever her spirit may be among the countless grains of sand and specks of dust between the harbor and the mountains... perhaps she will look at the Liyue of today, and steal a smile when she sees the prosperous land that it has become.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Mr. Dvorak!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ah, and Keqing's here too... Thanks for helping set all of this up.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: Welcome back. Did everything go well?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Really, really well! We found the person Mr. Dvorak was looking for!

dialogues.speaker: Dvorak
dialogues.text: A—Are you serious!?

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You recount the true story of the "fairy lady" to Keqing and Dvorak...

dialogues.speaker: Dvorak
dialogues.text: I see... So, the melody my ancestor heard was an adeptus remembering her late friend...

dialogues.speaker: Dvorak
dialogues.text: That certainly explains why it was such a powerful and poignant tune...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh. That's a really interesting first reaction. Guess that comes with having a musical mind.

dialogues.speaker: Dvorak
dialogues.text: ...I have to say, though, it's hard to believe that the fairy from the tale is now an elderly granny...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, Paimon knows exactly what you mean! Normally, adepti don't age at all!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But Streetward Rambler, or "Madame Ping" as we know her, probably only became old because it's what she wanted for herself.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: Madame Ping possesses vast knowledge and great wisdom. Whatever physical form she may decide to take, her mind and wits are as sharp as they come.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yep, Keqing summed it up perfectly! That's exactly what Paimon was trying to say.

dialogues.speaker: Dvorak
dialogues.text: I think... Yes, I must thank her in person.

dialogues.speaker: Dvorak
dialogues.text: That can wait until after the concert though. For now, I need to devote all my emotional energy to the performance.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ah, speaking of, Madame Ping wishes you all the best with the music festival!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon has a sneaking suspicion that she'll stay in her usual spot, but listen to the performances from afar!

dialogues.speaker: Dvorak
dialogues.text: ...Wait, are you serious?

dialogues.speaker: Dvorak
dialogues.text: Huh... Oh no, now I'm starting to get nervous...

choices.text: Relax.

response.speaker: Dvorak
response.text: Okay, alright...

response.speaker: Dvorak
response.text: Nope! Another rehearsal is in order. Please excuse me, everyone...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Mr. Dvorak! ...Ah, he's already gone. Paimon wasn't even finished telling him everything...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Before we set off on our search with Ganyu, he asked us about what music means to people. After our recent adventure, Paimon thinks we have a lot more to say about that now.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: Please, share your insights with me.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh, well... we found out that music can be used for good, but also for bad.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Um... It can make people happy and moved, but it can also be sad and bittersweet...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And music is like a kind of memory written in people's hearts. It can put you in touch with feelings from a totally different time and place.

choices.text: Pretty much. Though there was more to it than that.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: It sounds like you had an eventful trip... Don't worry, I'm sure Ganyu will fill me in on all the details shortly.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait, does that mean you're gonna carry on working?

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: Mm-hmm. Just a few things to wrap up. All the groundwork is done.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: As long as everyone enjoys the festival activities, all our efforts are worthwhile.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Happy Lantern Rite.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: Happy Lantern Rite to you as well.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Whew... that should be everything taken care of, right? Oh no, wait...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon feels like she's forgetting something... Ugh, what was it? Ugh, it feels like it was a while ago!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ah, shoot! Latent— Wait, no... anyway, uhh, fancy Bamboo Shoots!

choices.text: Bamboozle soup!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Zhongli said he wasn't in a hurry, so if we went now, there's probably still time, right?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Anyway, even if we don't make it, it's not our fault! He could've totally picked them by himself...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ugh, anyway, let's go check with him at Wangsheng Funeral Parlor.

choices.text: Made from "Nascent Bamboo Shoots"!
That was a broad summary, but not the most detailed.
Just treat it like any other performance.

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: Mm hmm! Da-da, da-da, da-da, da-da.

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: Dah-da-da-dah, dah-da-da-dah, oh!

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: Alright, let's take a break here.

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: Oh wow, look who it is! Are you here to hang out with everyone's favorite funeral director?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So you're just... casually practicing your rapping skills at the entrance to your funeral parlor... in broad daylight... Uhh, okay...

choices.text: You're, uh... freaking me out a little.

response.speaker: Hu Tao
response.text: Heheh, after everything we've been through... you don't see me for a hot minute, and you're back to being scared of your own shadow.

response.speaker: Hu Tao
response.text: We have all this open space, a clear view of the mountains behind and the sea in front... not to mention we have several invisible audience members enthusiastically cheering us on! It's the perfect spot to rehearse!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Invisible audience members...?

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: Gotta say, it took me a few days to get used to Director Hu's way of talking.

response.speaker: Yun Jin
response.text: Xinyan was pretty spooked too when she first got here! Just like when she sees a frog. But a giant frog. With sharp teeth!

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: C'mon, knock it off.

response.speaker: Hu Tao
response.text: What's wrong? I've never seen someone look so confused before. Well, don't worry, because Director Hu's here to explain it all!

response.speaker: Hu Tao
response.text:
There once was a Fontaine musician
Who went around town on a mission
He came door to door
For his Iridescence Tour
Looking for acts to audition

response.speaker: Hu Tao
response.text: With my words, Xinyan's chords, and Yun Jin as our mentor...

response.speaker: Hu Tao
response.text: We'll take the stage by storm, with flames roaring, and the whole audience calling for more!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Heck yeah!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: For sure! The whole dance floor will be yelling "encore, encore"! ...Ugh, now Paimon's rhyming along... Um, but when you say "flames roaring"... are you sure this'll be safe?

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: Ah, don't you worry about that! I'm pretty experienced on the stage, and I've already informed the Yuheng of all the pyrotechnics we're planning on using.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh... Guess we'll just have to trust Xinyan on this one.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Have you seen Zhongli, Director Hu?

response.speaker: Hu Tao
response.text: Oh, Zhongli? He took one of those fancy meal boxes and set off for the mountains. Said he wanted to pay a visit to some old friends.

response.speaker: Yun Jin
response.text: It's a real pity that he couldn't be around for this. As well as being a true connoisseur of traditional art forms, he's able to appreciate Xinyan's performances, too...

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: Yeah, that's right! Matter of fact, he was the one who first invited me to perform here.

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: To tell the truth, though, I never thought I'd really find myself rehearsing here one day...

response.speaker: Hu Tao
response.text: Hehe, well, now you know: The Wangsheng Funeral Parlor is a great location! All of you are always welcome to come and hang out here, especially if you're in the mood to try something new!

response.speaker: Yun Jin
response.text: I can speak to that. Hu Tao is always full of fun surprises!

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: ...And jump scares.

response.speaker: Yun Jin
response.text: Actually, Xinyan, I have some lyric ideas for your part. Do you wanna go through them together?

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: Sure thing! I'm all ears.

response.speaker: Hu Tao
response.text: #Oh, {NICKNAME} and Paimon, I believe Zhongli was heading to Mt. Hulao. So, make sure you're hiking up the right hill!

response.speaker: Hu Tao
response.text: When you see Zhongli, please pass on this message to him: It's up to him whether he wants to support us at the performance tonight... but I expect him to make time for the upcoming banquet we're planning. No excuses!

response.speaker: Hu Tao
response.text: You should join us too! It'll be a riot. If there's one thing I've learned from being a funeral director, it's how to throw a party!

choices.text: I... uh... wow.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon sees them! It's Illuminated Deer and Illuminated Bird number two.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Greetings, everyone. Long time no see.

dialogues.speaker: Moon Carver
dialogues.text: Hmm... A familiar face. Have you come from Liyue Harbor? How is the city nowadays?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Everything's great! But you know, if you're so curious, you can always go and check it out for yourself.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: In fact, Moon Carver has been taking many walks on Mt. Tianheng in recent times. I believe the sights of the city are quite familiar to him.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Zhongli! Here you are. We've brought the Bamboo Shoots you wanted.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Impeccable timing.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Zhongli puts the nascent Bamboo Shoots into the cooking mechanism next to him. Moon Carver and Mountain Shaper power it using their Adeptus Arts...

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Traditionally, Bamboo Shoot Soup ought to be slow-cooked for many hours on low heat. Using Adeptus Arts to hasten the process is something of a shortcut.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, that mechanism... Is that...

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Indeed. Cloud Retainer kindly lent me her supreme cuisine machine.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Can we not just call it a "cooking machine"? ..Ugh, actually never mind.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: She seems to take a lot of pride in her mechanical gizmos, so it's probably best if Paimon doesn't go changing the name willy-nilly.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: I trust that you found the answers you were seeking during your recent journey?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Yes.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Excellent.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: The past should be remembered, but not overly dwelt upon. Our journeys should be seen as a means to take on more from the world around us.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: When the Bamboo Shoot Soup is ready, I must insist that you try some for yourself.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Of course!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, Zhongli, Hu Tao told us to tell you something!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: She said: "It's up to him whether he wants to support us at the performance tonight... but I expect him to make time for the upcoming banquet we're planning. No excuses!"

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: When she says "performance," she must mean the Lantern Rite music festival!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: As for the banquet, uh... she didn't tell us anything more about that, but she invited us to come as well.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: As you can see, I have a prior engagement with two adepti friends of mine tonight. Please give Director Hu my best wishes for the performance.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: As for the banquet... Hmm, since the Director insists, far be it from a mere consultant like myself to refuse.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yay! Then we'll see you there?

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Absolutely.

dialogues.speaker: Mountain Shaper
dialogues.text: Rex Lapis, the Bamboo Shoot Soup is ready.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Thank you. I will examine it right away.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: The appearance is exquisite, and the aroma rich and intense. The craftsmanship of this machine is commendable indeed.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Since you came all this way, you should not leave empty-handed. Please take some soup. It tastes most exquisite while still warm.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: (The Integrated CS will be automatically triggered if the player returns to the Liyue Harbor performance venue between 18:00 and 20:00)

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: Ping, what say you to convening more often in the future?

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: That would be quite wonderful. But I must say, after all this time, I've grown quite accustomed to the harbor... When we are to meet, I shall have to trouble you to make the journey to the city.

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: You sound just like Shenhe. The child is constantly telling one all sorts of stories from the city, as if one was partial to them...

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: Have you ever considered moving to the city, Cloud Retainer? There are plenty of people here to talk to. I think you would find it quite the antidote to the monotony of solitude.

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: And if you looked around, I suspect you would find some young minds with an interest in the mechanical arts — some of them even worth training.

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: Haha. We shall see.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: I intend to reminisce with my old friends for a while longer. You ought to get back to Liyue Harbor. There is a performance you do not want to miss.

dialogues.speaker: Mountain Shaper
dialogues.text: Had one known that Cloud Retainer was in possession of such eminently useful devices, one would have sought to borrow one from her long ago...

dialogues.speaker: Moon Carver
dialogues.text: And yet, since you share my lack of enthusiasm for mechanisms and fine dining, it would have become a mere decorative ornament in your abode.

dialogues.speaker: Mountain Shaper
dialogues.text: Not so. Had one had such a device to make up for one's lack of culinary prowess, Shenhe would not have had to rely on flowers and herbs alone for sustenance while under one's care...

dialogues.speaker: Moon Carver
dialogues.text: Hmm... in that case, shall we rendezvous with Cloud Retainer one day soon, and request to borrow one more supreme cuisine machine?

dialogues.speaker: Mountain Shaper
dialogues.text: A fine idea... a fine idea indeed.

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: Okay, everyone, I think that's a long-enough break. Let's take it from the top, shall we?

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: Ms. Yun is such a strict mentor! These breaks aren't even long enough to have a sip of tea.

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: Hah, well, you were desperate to get involved, and this is what it takes. If I gave you half the chance, you'd be sipping tea till nightfall.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Hey, how about I treat us all to some late night snacks once we're done! Hu Tao, whatcha cravin'?

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: Hmm... how about some Stir-Fried Filet with a side of Crab Roe Tofu?

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Hehe... Where are we gonna find Crab Roe Tofu so late at night?

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: We could always just go pester Masterful Chef, Xiangling.

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: Mmm, now I'm hungry. Alright, let's knock this out and then go grab some food!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: I'm sure we don't have to worry about her work. I just hope everything goes well after that.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Help! Heeeelp! Someone's drowning!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: If only there was a kindhearted adeptus here to save us... Oh no, whatever will a Paimon do?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Alright, let's go tell Mr. Dvorak the news!
